data.one_liner: Flutter widget that builds an input field with input chips options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget for managing input chips alongside a text input field. It allows users to type and add values as chips, which can then be easily accessed or modified.
use_when: You need a text input field that converts typed text into removable chips.
You want to limit the maximum number of chips a user can add.
avoid_when: You need complex autocomplete functionality combined with chip selection that the widget does not support.
strengths: Easy integration with initial values and max chip limits.
Includes an InputChipsController for programmatic access to chip values.
Customizable appearance including decorations, text styles, and spacing.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond the basic README example.
No built-in autocomplete or asynchronous search out of the box based on documented properties.
